name: Chelsea Chandler
event: UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott
summary: A powerful, physical former featherweight (7-4, 3-3 UFC) out of Cesar Gracie Jiu-Jitsu who does her best work early: all four of her stoppage wins came in rounds one or two, most recently a round-one armbar of Priscila Cachoeira in June. Has a history of weight misses at 135 and was TKO'd in round one by Joselyne Edwards.

how_they_fight.Striking: Short, heavy punches (uppercut, short right); the right hand that dropped Cachoeira and the stoppage of Julija Stoliarenko both came in round one. Hittable at range: Yana Santos out-landed her 94-56 and Edwards finished her against the fence.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Strong top game and back-taking: took Josiane Nunes's back and mounted her (7 minutes of control), and against Cachoeira took the back with both hooks before switching to the armbar. Can be held down by bigger wrestlers (Norma Dumont, 9 minutes of control).
how_they_fight.Defense: Defensive striking is the weakness (absorbs more than she lands per our numbers). Stopped once: TKO at 2:31 of round one vs Edwards after going down covering up.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Fast starter who fades or gets out-worked late. Finishes: R1 x3, R2 x1, none in round three. Against Nunes she won rounds one and two but was walked down in round three; her three decision losses were to fighters who out-worked her over 15 minutes. If she doesn't hurt you early, the later rounds tend to belong to the opponent.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Opportunistic: capitalises quickly when an opponent is hurt. Recovered from falling to her back early against Cachoeira.

patterns: Explodes on hurt opponents; takes the back
Missed weight twice in 2024 (Nunes, 1 lb; Yana Santos, 141 lb, 5 over)
concerns: Weight cut to 135 (two misses in 2024; made 135 vs Cachoeira)
Fighting with injuries per her own comments; neck treatment
Durability in exchanges at range (R1 TKO loss)
keys_to_beat: Survive round one; drag her into rounds two and three
Work at range with volume and kicks; avoid the clinch
Don't scramble loosely: she takes backs

news.text: After the Cachoeira win she said she threw up more in camp than ever, had been fighting with injuries, and had stem-cell treatment on her neck; camp expanded beyond Cesar Gracie to more cross-training (per Cageside Press).
Ended a two-fight skid with a round-one armbar of Priscila Cachoeira (3:42) after more than a year away; earned a $25,000 finisher bonus per Cageside Press.
Weighed 141 lb for Yana Santos fight, five over the bantamweight limit; also missed by a pound for Josiane Nunes in March 2024.
